purpose: Teach: 産婦人科/寝台/かばん/軍用/牡丹/キャラメル/弾丸/アクリル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのご友人が、産婦人科でお仕事してるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, my friend works as an obstetrician. Did you know that?
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Quiet opening. Soft cadence, like she's noticing something small about the world and sharing it with him. Warm but not rushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと寝台列車に乗りたい
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to ride a sleeper train with Dad sometime.
lines.style: Bright, direct eagerness with a child's earnestness. Quick pickup on the request. Slight lean forward in the voice. Not demanding — asking hopefully.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんがかわいいかばんをくれたわね
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother gave you such a lovely little bag, didn't she?
lines.style: Warm noticing. Slight smile in the voice. Quiet appreciation of a small kindness. Lingering gently on the word 'lovely' — savoring it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、博物館で軍用ヘルメット見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw military helmets at the museum today!
lines.style: Excited and proud. Quick pace. Open, bright delivery. Eyes lighting up in the voice — sharing something he found genuinely interesting. Genuine child delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんのお庭に牡丹がきれいに咲いてるわ
lines.en: Sho, the peonies in your grandfather's garden are blooming so beautifully right now.
lines.style: Soft, contemplative. Unhurried pace. Lingers on the image. There's care in noticing this detail for him. Voice settles like she's inviting him to see what she sees.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんからキャラメルもらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa gave me a caramel today!
lines.style: Bright, pleased announcement. Slight pride that Grandpa noticed him. Quick delivery. Voice full of simple, uncomplicated joy. A small treasure being shared.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが弾丸列車のお話してくれたわよ
lines.en: Sho, your father was telling me about the Shinkansen earlier.
lines.style: Gentle, connecting him to his dad through memory. Warm tone. Slight pause before 'Shinkansen' — savoring the word. Understated, like she's letting him know something good was said about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、アクリル絵の具でお絵描きしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I painted a picture with acrylic paints!
lines.style: Pride and accomplishment ring clearly. Confident pace. Voice opens up — he's proud of his work and wants to show her. Bright but genuine, not showing off.
